items.title: 1 Stock Under $50 on Our Watchlist and 2 We Question
items.summary: Stocks in the $10-50 range offer a sweet spot between affordability and stability as they’re typically more established than penny stocks. But their headline prices don’t guarantee quality, and investors should exercise caution as some have shaky business models.
